recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q1 2026 Results Analysis - Profit Swing and Renewable Fuel Rebound
recent_news.summary: Q1 2026 earnings release shows revenue rose to US$1,550.82 million and net income to US$134.31 million, lifting diluted EPS to US$0.83 from a loss a year earlier. Sharp Q1 2026 swing back to profit and the rebound at Diamond Green Diesel directly support the key short term catalyst of margin recovery in renewable fuels.
